newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Seven found shot dead in Russian holiday complex.
newsitem.headline: Seven found shot dead in Russian holiday complex.

text.p: Russian police said on Wednesday workers at a complex of holiday cottages in Siberia had found seven dead people whose bodies were riddled with bullet holes.
The killings, which took place on Tuesday, may have been the result of a gangland quarrel, said a police spokesman in Surgut in the autonomous oil-producing region of Khanti-Mansiisk.
"I don't remember a case in which so many people were gunned down in cold blood in our region," he added.
Gangland killings have become commonplace in Russia in the past few years as rival criminal groups vie for stakes in the post-communist market economy.
